data.name: help5
data.title: Common Problem
data.content:
1.What is AmazonBOT?

AmazonBOT is a marketing and promotion company that helps Amazon.com merchantsaround the world get more sales on their orders and increase browsing data on Amazon's online store. We are committed to establishing a three-way profitable marketing promotion model between Amazon, merchants and consumers.

Combined with the latest P2P blockchain technology, the business policy of quickly connecting consumers and merchants through USDT (TRC20, ERC20). Registered users get commissions for orders, while merchants increase store sa es data. The latest profit mocel under the Internet blockchain model!

 

2.How does the AmazonBOT work??

Daily Amazon Feedback shows which products in Amazon's sales need to increase salesThe user only needs to click the order with one click, and the system will automatically generate the order subscription. Users pay the order amount through the blockchain USDT and get a daily commission.

 

3.Why is there a difference in the price of the same currency between two transactions?

All factors that are not conducive to the free flow of currency can lead to price differences, these factors include currency transfer speed, network conditions, currency access iestrictions, recognition of currency by people in different regions, and even the types oftransactions offered by exchanges, transactions, etc. Therefore, the same currency mayhave price differences in different transactions.

 

4.Investment profit?

The higher the price of the item you get, the higher the profit on the order you get. At the same time, AmazonBOT randomly distributes large commission orders.

data.name: help4
data.title: Trading Rules
data.content:
The system automatically generates and distributes 60 commodity orders to users every day. Users complete each order payment in USDT and receive a 0.06% commission. The system randomly assigns large commission orders.

USDT can be withdrawn after completing 60 orders. (lf 60 orders are not completed, thesystem will automatically stop until the number of remaining orders on the day.)

data.name: help3
data.title: How to recharge?
data.content: Before recharging, please bind your withdrawal address (support TRC-20) USDT address, you can go to the APP or webpage and click recharge, and select the blockchain (TRC20) you use to recharge.

data.name: help2
data.title: How to withdraw?
data.content: After placing an order every day, you can withdraw normally, and the withdrawal will arrive within 24 hours after the withdrawal is initiated, and there is no withdrawal limit.

data.name: help1
data.title: How to invite friends?
data.content:
You can invite them via invite link or invite code and they will become your team members after successful registration.

When you invite friends to join, you can earn 30% of the daily income of low-level friends who complete orders. Lv1-59%, LV2-19%, L3-15%.
